Sunday, December 6, 2026 | 4:00–6:30 p.m. Location: Coventry Clock Tower


Join us at the Coventry Clock Tower as we kick off the holiday season with our annual Light Up the Clock Tower celebration!


Bring your family, friends, and holiday spirit for a festive evening filled with community traditions, holiday cheer, and fun for all ages.


✨ A Holiday Celebration for the Whole Community


Enjoy an evening of:

  • Free family activities

  • A special visit from Santa

  • Holiday performances by Coventry school choir and band programs

  • Refreshments for the community

  • Opportunities to support local families in need - The Portage Lakes Kiwanis will also be collecting donations to help support local families during the holiday season.


🎁 Help Us Light Up the Clock Tower!


This special community tradition is made possible through the generosity of local businesses, organizations, and residents.

Coventry Township is currently seeking sponsors, donations, and volunteers to help make this year's celebration a memorable holiday experience for our community.

Whether you are a local business looking to support the community, an organization interested in contributing, or a resident who would like to lend a helping hand, we welcome your participation!

Sponsorship opportunities are available at several levels:

  • Event Sponsor – $5,000

  • Santa’s Helper – $1,000–$2,500

  • Silver Bells – $500

  • Garland – $250

  • Mistletoe – $100

Sponsorships help cover event activities, refreshments, supplies, and other expenses that make this celebration possible. Recognition opportunities include event signage, Township electronic sign displays, social media recognition, and acknowledgment during the event, depending on the sponsorship level.

In-kind donations of refreshments, food, cups, napkins, children's activities, entertainment, event supplies, and other services are also welcome.
